items.title: 2.4 Equations of motion (motion ki equations) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.4 with Figs. 2.5 to 2.7 and Examples 2.2 to 2.4 (PDF 28-33, printed 25-30).

blocks.text: Equations of motion kisi cheez ki motion ko teen kinematic variables se describe karti hain: velocity (v), position (s) aur time (t). In teenon ke pairs (jore) teen tarah bante hain: velocity-time, position-time aur velocity-position. Isi order (tarteeb) se inhen pehli, doosri aur teesri equation of motion kehte hain.
Yeh equations sirf un cheezon par lagti hain jo straight line (seedhi line) mein constant (na badalne wali) acceleration se chal rahi hon.
Derivation of First Equation of Motion (pehli equation nikaalna)

Farz karein ek body straight line mein uniform acceleration se chal rahi hai aur us ki initial (shuru ki) velocity vi hai. Time t mein us ki velocity vi se badal kar final (aakhri) velocity vf ho jati hai. Acceleration velocity ke change ko time se divide karne se milta hai:
Isay rearrange kar ke (tarteeb badal kar) likhein:
Yeh pehli equation of motion hai. Yeh batati hai ke constant acceleration a se chalti body ki final velocity, initial velocity aur time t se kaise judi hai.
Derivation of First Equation of Motion By Graphical Method (graph se pehli equation)
Pehli equation velocity-time graph se bhi nikal sakte hain, jab cheez initial velocity vi, final velocity vf aur constant acceleration a se chal rahi ho.
Graph par point A par velocity vi hai jo time t mein point B par vf ho jati hai (Fig. 2.5). B se x-axis par perpendicular BD aur y-axis par perpendicular BE banayein. Is tarah:

blocks.latex: BD = v_f = \text{Final velocity of the body}
blocks.text_alt: BD = vf = Final velocity of the body

Derivation of Second Equation of Motion (doosri equation nikaalna)

Farz karein body uniform acceleration a se straight line mein chal rahi hai, initial velocity vi hai jo time t ke baad vf ho jati hai, aur is dauran woh ek direction mein distance S tay karti hai. Velocity ki definition hai displacement badalne ka rate, is liye:
Agar velocity constant na ho to velocity ki jagah average velocity lete hain. Uniform acceleration mein average velocity = (shuru ki velocity + aakhri velocity)/2. Is liye:
Pehli equation se vf = vi + at rakhein:

blocks.latex: \text{Using first equation of motion,}\quad S = \frac{(v_i + v_i + at)}{2} \times t
blocks.text_alt: Using first equation of motion, S = (vi + vi + at)/2 × t

blocks.text: Yeh doosri equation of motion hai.
Derivation of Second Equation by Graphical Method (graph se doosri equation)
Velocity-time graph lein: body initial velocity vi se chal kar time t mein vf tak pohanchti hai, constant acceleration a ke saath, aur is dauran displacement S tay karti hai.

blocks.text: Graph ke neeche ka area OABD tay kiya hua distance S hai. Ise do parts mein dekhein: neeche rectangle OACD, jis ka area OA × OD = vi × t hai, aur us ke oopar triangle ABC, jis ka area ½ × AC × BC = ½ × t × at hai. Dono ko add karne se S = vit + ½at² milta hai.
Graph se dikhta hai ke tay kiya distance S = v × t hai, yani graph ke neeche ka area:

Yahi teesri equation of motion hai.

Equations of motion straight line mein uniform acceleration wali motion ke sawal hal karne mein kaam aati hain. Agar motion ki direction na badle to sab vector quantities ko scalars ki tarah add-subtract kar sakte hain. Aise mein initial velocity ko positive lete hain, aur jo quantity us ki ulti direction mein ho use negative sign dete hain. Air resistance (hawa ki rukawat) na ho to Zameen ki surface ke paas free fall (khud girti) har cheez Zameen ki taraf ek hi uniform acceleration se aati hai. Ise acceleration due to gravity kehte hain, g se likhte hain, aur Zameen ki surface par is ki average value 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf li jati hai. Free fall par bhi yahi equations lagti hain; bas a ki jagah g likh dein.

blocks.title: Example 2.2
blocks.problem: 10 m s⁻¹ se chalti car 2 m s⁻² ke uniform acceleration se accelerate hoti (tez hoti) hai. 5 s baad us ki velocity nikalein.
steps: Given: vi = 10 m s⁻¹, a = 2 m s⁻², t = 5 s; maloom karna hai vf.
vf = 10 m s⁻¹ + 2 m s⁻² × 5 s

blocks.title: Example 2.3
blocks.problem: Car 15 m s⁻¹ ki initial velocity se chalti hai aur 4 seconds tak 2 m s⁻² ke rate se accelerate hoti hai. Car ka displacement nikalein.
steps: Given: vi = 15 m s⁻¹, a = 2 m s⁻², t = 4 s; maloom karna hai S.
Values rakhein: S = (15 m s⁻¹ × 4 s) + ½(2 m s⁻²)(4 s)²

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne values rakhte waqt (16 s)² likha hai; sahi (4 s)² = 16 s² hai. Kitab ka answer 76 m sahi hai, kyun ke calculation mein 16 s² hi istemal hua hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.4
blocks.problem: Short distance (chhote faasle) ki race mein car rest (ruki hui halat) se chalti hai aur constant acceleration se 0.45 km tay kar ke 300 km h⁻¹ ki velocity tak pohanchti hai. Yeh acceleration nikalein.
steps: Given: vi = 0, vf = 300 km h⁻¹, S = 0.45 km.
km h⁻¹ ko m s⁻¹ mein badlein (1 km = 1000 m, 1 h = 60 × 60 s): vf = (300 × 1000)/(60 × 60) m s⁻¹ = 250/3 m s⁻¹ ≈ 83.3 m s⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein velocity ki line dobara chhapi hai aur us mein (300×1000×250)/(60×60) m s⁻¹ likha hai; is mein ×250 ghalat hai (is se 20 833 m s⁻¹ banta). Sahi conversion (300×1000)/(60×60) = 250/3 m s⁻¹ hai. Kitab ki baqi calculation 250/3 hi leti hai, is liye answer 7.72 m s⁻² sahi hai.

blocks.caption: Teen equations of motion (ek nazar mein)
rows: BD = BC + OA; line AB ka slope = a
trapezium OABD ka area, t = (vf - vi)/a rakh kar

blocks.prompt: Ek train 30 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai aur 600 m mein uniform taur par ruk jati hai. Us ki deceleration (speed kam hone ka rate) aur laga hua time nikalein. Har ek ke liye kaun si equation lagegi, aur acceleration negative kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Teesri equation: 2aS = vf² - vi², to a = (0 - 900)/(2 × 600) = -0.75 m s⁻². Pehli equation: t = (vf - vi)/a = (0 - 30)/(-0.75) = 40 s. Initial velocity ko positive lete hain; train dheemi ho rahi hai, is liye acceleration ulti direction mein hai aur us par negative sign aata hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Constant a se straight line motion: vf = vi + at; S = vit + ½at²; 2aS = vf² - vi². Graph se: v-t line ka slope = a, aur graph ke neeche ka area = S (rectangle + triangle, ya trapezium).
Initial velocity positive, ulti direction wali quantities negative; free fall mein a ki jagah g = 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf. Examples ke answers: 20 m s⁻¹; 76 m; 7.72 m s⁻².
